gizmo.title: Stop Note Group
gizmo.description: Stack several stop notes into one block that shows a note at a time, such as Tips or What's new. Instruction cards, side notes and framed quotes can be stacked with them.

configure.title: Label
configure.description: Name for the group that screen readers announce, such as Tips or What's new.

configure.title: Notes
configure.description: The stop notes in the group. Instruction cards, side notes and framed quotes can be added too.

demoSchema.content:
Import turns Word, PDF, PowerPoint and more into a HAX site.

Pages are web-standard HTML in plain files you own.

Tip and What's new join Note, Success, Warning and Stop.
